design: general containerized native EDA command resolution
docstring: Keep an executable built-in legacy tool default; otherwise discover that command on the container PATH, while preserving explicit operator commands and missing-tool refusal.
pattern: A container image provides a native EDA binary on PATH, but the MCP adapter invokes a built-in absolute legacy path that no longer exists, causing doctor and native consumers to report an unavailable tool.
fix_action: Augment the existing MCP index adapter with a shared deterministic resolver for built-in legacy defaults: use an executable legacy path when present, otherwise resolve its bare command inside the selected container. Preserve explicit operator commands byte-for-byte and propagate missing-command failures. Use the resolved commands in existing doctor and native consumers without a new per-tool environment framework or acceptance gate. Preserve shell quoting in the actual assembled DFT script and stop before success markers or PASS manifests when required dependencies or a Fault operation fail.
before_state: REAL: fresh Codex and Claude MCP clients connected with 56 tools and alive health; both eda_doctor calls returned success=false and 8/17 checks passed, with all nine native EDA tool checks unavailable through stale /foss paths. The actual DFT registered-handler control could also publish success/PASS after missing commands; quote reversion breaks the neutral positive control.
after_state: MEASURED BOUNDED SOURCE: exact patch e9c10b32e819df1f41ee734d3be3b1f44129801af4a3bdee9aee81d1bc12599b changes source doctor from 8/17 to 17/17 and real native KLayout fixture parsing from unavailable to 10 GDS cells. All 13 matched candidate controls PASS; legacy priority, failing legacy no-fallback, true absence and explicit missing operator commands preserve refusal. Actual DFT scripts preserve quotes and emit no PASS manifest on dependency or Fault failure. Installed Codex/Claude proof remains PENDING_ROOT_INSTALL; their actual prior doctor 8/17 is preserved.
ai_reasoning: NATIVE_PATH_READBACK.json records all nine image binaries present on container PATH, while the fresh MCP doctor receipts select unavailable legacy paths. Executability checks and container-side command discovery are deterministic adapter responsibilities, so this is Bucket A at the existing MCP owner rather than a forked-tool enhancement or skill-only guidance. Availability readback does not qualify native tool behavior.
generality: The rule depends on configured command origin, executability and container PATH; it does not branch on a design, PDK, benchmark identifier, score, oracle or image-specific installation prefix.
capture_scope: Actual local MCP path defect and bounded adapter repair. Native probes cover nine version checks and actual KLayout ten-cell fixture parsing; DFT controls execute actual scripts using neutral tool fixtures. Full native ATPG, end-to-end flow qualification and benchmark scores are NOT_RUN here; final installed-client qualification belongs to root.
